# Peter Zalar

> Peter Zalar, Ph.D., is a Senior OLED Device Engineer at Apple (Cupertino, California) with 17 years of experience in organic and printed electronics. He has 41 publications, 14 patent families, an h-index of 25 and 5,537+ citations (Google Scholar). Research areas: organic electronics, OLEDs, printed and flexible sensors, wearable devices, thin-film devices.

## Background
- Ph.D. research on organic semiconductors at UC Santa Barbara
- University of Tokyo: ultraflexible organic optoelectronics for biomedical applications (JST ERATO)
- Holst Centre / TNO (Netherlands), seven years: managed large-area printed sensor research programs
- Apple: OLED device engineering
- Languages: English (native), Japanese (JLPT N2), Dutch, Croatian, Italian, Spanish
